resume.description: The last sequence number the end has seen.

crypto.description: The scheme the two ends agree the payload on, and the key material of this end. The public key and the nonce prefix are base64url without padding — the same encoding as the sealed blob.

public.description: The uncompressed P-256 public key of this end (65 bytes), base64url without padding.

prefix.description: The four bytes this end prefixes its nonces with, base64url without padding.
